model_access.name: Model & openness
model_access.ask: Whose model does it use? Can you switch to a third party? How is multi-model routing configured?

runtime.name: Where it runs
runtime.ask: Local, cloud or hybrid? Is the index local or remote? Remote control is not the same as cloud execution.

local_files.name: Local files
local_files.ask: How wide an area can it reach? How does it read large files you have not opened? How capable is it at the symbol level?

background.name: Tasks after shutdown
background.ask: Does it keep running once the computer is off? This is the most common misconception about local forms.

tools.name: Tools & extensions
tools.ask: How wide is the toolchain: MCP · LSP · plugins · hooks · custom instructions?

context.name: Context & memory
context.ask: Indexing algorithm, context window, session resume and fork, and the boundary of cross-session memory.

permissions.name: Permissions & limits
permissions.ask: Sandbox and approval boundaries, credential handling, whether data leaves your machine, and how quota is charged.

fit.name: Best for
fit.ask: What tasks is it best at? When should you not use it?

transport.name: Transport
transport.ask: How the client connects to it: stdio / SSE / Streamable HTTP / remote.

auth.name: Authentication
auth.ask: How identity is proved. Note that authentication is not authorisation: the former is who you are, the latter is what you may do.

scope.name: Permission scope
scope.ask: How much can it reach? Can it modify? Delete? Be tightened? This is the first priority in the MCP track.
